summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Configurations
summary.text: Catalog entries 194–212 from an astrological codex, covering accompanying stars, local distinctions, centers, planetary mixtures and configurations, longevity, honors, questions, animal subjection, absent persons, love and marriage, testimonies, royal years, conjunctions, and full moons. Authorities and references include the Babylonians, Chakmakln, Thebour, codex 6, and specified folios.
